description: Symbolic closed-form y_λ for n = 2, ..., 12 via the Wenzl bridge: y_λ = s_{λ, r}(Q) / Σ_µ d_µ s_{µ, r}(Q) with Q = q² and r solved from q · z = Q^r (1-Q) / (1-Q^r), z = q³/(q²+1) (CONVENTION D), which forces r = 2 exactly. Since r is the number of variables in the Schur principal specialisation, r = 2 is a two-dimensional fibre and y_λ = 0 identically for ℓ(λ) ≥ 3 — of the 270 partitions here, the 223 with three or more rows are exact zeros. Convention C (z = 1/(q^{1/2} + q^{-1/2})) solved to a non-integer r, so no weight vanished. Computed via sympy with Q^r treated as the symbolic placeholder X = q · z / (1 - Q + q · z), giving exact q-rational expressions in Q(q^{1/2}). Bypasses the O(p(n)³) linear-system solve by using the O(p(n) · max_hooks) Schur principal-specialization formula. Tractable through n = 12 in seconds.
